# Frozen V1 reference and synthetic V1 fixture (V3 Slice 1 · C1)

Test-only material for the V3 data-format work. Nothing here is loaded by the app.

"V1" means the storage and backup format of the V2 app as merged at commit
`936753bd4bb07ff9a5047cc60c6271a6165a487b` (format version 1). Later V3 commits upgrade data
from this format, so they need a fixed copy of the old app and old-format data to test against.

## What is frozen

`tests/fixtures/v1-app/` holds byte copies of every file under these paths at the frozen commit,
at the same relative paths:

- `src/` (the whole V1 domain, browser and Node adapters)
- `data/schemas/`, `data/foods/core-foods.json`, `data/meals/library-meals.json`, `data/targets.json`
- `user-data/` (the first-run seed files)

The copies come from the Git object database (`git cat-file`), never from the working tree.
`manifest.json` pins each file's Git blob ID, SHA-256 and size.

## What is synthetic

Two seed files are replaced, so no real user data is copied into fixtures:

| File | Replaced with | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `user-data/custom-foods.json` | one fictional food, `food_custom_synthetic_test_bar` | the original holds Custom Foods migrated from the user's own app |
| `data/targets.json` | fictional whole-number targets | the original holds the user's actual daily targets |

The manifest keeps each original's Git blob ID (for traceability) and pins the replacement's own
SHA-256 and blob ID. These two files are the only ones excluded from the byte-identity check.
The frozen application code is not changed to accommodate them: the frozen app only reads
these files as first-run seed data.

`backup.json` and `store-record.json` are the synthetic V1 fixture: a V1 backup and the matching
V1 IndexedDB store record, generated by driving the frozen app (`generate.mjs`) with a fixed
clock, date and IDs. All five collections (targets, custom foods, saved meals, days,
preferences) are synthetic. They cover all three day types, done, in-progress and empty days, a
corrected day type, changed targets, meals logged from Library and Saved Meals, ad-hoc and
single-food logs, an edited logged meal, a deleted Custom Food still in history, a Saved Meal
needing a replacement, a Library copy, favourites and dislikes.

## What is intentionally excluded

V1 UI (`app/`), `data/reference/`, `migration/`, V1 tests, retired legacy files and root
documents. None of them is loaded by the V1 runtime. Old-app UI behaviour is checked in the
real-browser rehearsal instead.

## Checking and rebuilding

- `node tests/tools/backup-report.mjs verify --git` checks every pinned hash, the reference
  directory's file list, the fixtures, and (with `--git`) every blob ID against the frozen
  commit. It is read-only, offline, and prints counts and hashes only. It exits 1 on any
  integrity failure.
- `node tests/tools/backup-report.mjs report <file>` prints counts and hashes for one V1 backup
  or store record. It refuses files inside the repository unless they are these fixtures:
  keep real backups outside the repository.
- `tests/v1-reference.test.mjs` runs the same checks in the test suite, plus a validate-and-restore
  round trip and a recovery-path restore through the frozen V1 app.
- `node tests/fixtures/v1/build-reference.mjs --write` rebuilds everything here from the frozen
  commit (needs local Git; no network). Rebuilding produces identical files.
